_comment: English localizable user-facing strings for Defenders of the Realm. Verbatim from narrative-bible.md §7 and src/content/story.ts. Flat dotted keys suitable for the Unity Localization package string table. Multi-variant lines are numbered .1 .2 etc; pick at random per trigger.
title.tagline: Hold the Chord. Defend the Spire.
title.tagline.legacy.bible: Tend the Heart. Hold the dark.
title.tagline.legacy.story: Tend the Lantern. Hold the dark.
intro.coldOpen.line1: In an old valley, an old tree.
intro.coldOpen.line2: In the dark beyond, a slow cold rot.
intro.coldOpen.line3: You are the Keeper. The song is yours now.
tutorial.firstVillageLoad: Welcome home, Keeper. The Heart hums for you. Walk a while - the song will tell you what it needs.
tutorial.firstApproachHeart: This is Elarion. Touch the dais. The crystal will remember you.
tutorial.firstCrystalClaim: The Heart gives what it can spare. Hold these - you will need them.
tutorial.firstBuildingUnlock: The Folk built these long before you. Each one tends to the Heart in its own way.
tutorial.firstStoreVisit: What you cannot grow here, the wanderers bring. Spend wisely. Coins are slow to earn.
tutorial.firstDefenseRun: The dark has noticed us. Place your companions at the slots. They will know what to do.
tutorial.firstPetPlacement: A spirit at a slot defends. A spirit at a building tends. They cannot do both at once.
tutorial.firstAbilityCastQ: This is your magic, but it is the Heart's gift. Use what is given. It returns when it can.
tutorial.firstFrostNovaW: For when a lane fails. The cold buys you a breath. Use the breath well.
tutorial.firstBeaconE: Plant light where the dark gathers thickest. The towers within will fight braver.
tutorial.firstMeteorR: This is the deep magic. Spend it only when the Heart calls for it.
tutorial.steps.1: Welcome home, Keeper. The spire holds the realm's last song. Protect it.
tutorial.steps.2: The Hollowed come from the dark beyond the walls. They want to extinguish the Light.
tutorial.steps.3: Build your defenses with what you have. Walk to the Crystal Mine - tap to gather.
tutorial.steps.4: Good. Spend crystals at the Workshop to upgrade your defenses.
tutorial.steps.5: When you are ready, begin a wave. Tap a skill to cast - your magic returns when the spire allows.
tutorial.steps.6: Your Wardens fight beside you. Tap one to give them a station.
tutorial.steps.7: The spire remembers your kindness. Tend it well, Keeper.
tutorial.steps.forceField: The walls hold a force-field of the Heart's own light - see it shimmer in the gates. It turns the Hollowed back while it shines. But every blow thins it, and a thinned field lets the dark slip through. Keep the walls and gates mended, and the light keeps its strength.
gate.firstSeen: The Heart's light parts for those it knows. Walk through, Keeper - but the Hollow Ones will press against it. Mend the gate as you mend the walls.
gate.firstDestroyed: The gate has fallen. They come through unhindered. Hold the inner ring and repair the field before the next dark.
gate.firstRepaired: The light remembers you. The gate holds again.
wave.warning.ice.1: They come from the cold places. They will move slowly, and bite hard.
wave.warning.ice.2: The frost-marked are at the gates. Keep your fires lit.
wave.warning.fire.1: The ember-bound come, hungry for the green things. Hold the eastern lanes.
wave.warning.fire.2: They burn as they march. Do not let them touch the Heart's roots.
wave.warning.aether.1: Wisps of the unmade - quick, half-here. Aim true.
wave.warning.aether.2: The half-souls drift in. They feel the Heart's pull. Turn them back.
wave.warning.mixed.1: A many-tongued tide. Read the lanes before you place.
wave.warning.mixed.2: They come from every dark. Trust your Wardens.
wave.warning.boss.1: Alduin the Mournful walks at the head of this tide. He was a healer, once. Greet him with steel.
wave.warning.boss.2: He returns when the Withering finds purchase. Send him back.
wave.warning.apex.1: Syndrath the Devourer circles the Heart. The sky itself has turned against us. Keep your eyes up, Keeper.
wave.warning.apex.2: A black wing crosses the sun. The Devourer hunts where the realm is weakest - do not let it find the Heart wanting.
heartVoice.serene.toVigilant: The song shifts. The dark is at the gates.
heartVoice.vigilant.toWarning: A lane wavers. The Heart felt it before you did.
heartVoice.warning.toDanger: The walls are thinning. The Heart calls for you.
heartVoice.danger.toCritical: The song breaks. Defend, Keeper - defend now.
heartVoice.critical.toSerene: The Heart settles. The folk breathe again.
heartVoice.boss: He stands within the gate. Time slows. The light dims.
heartVoice.victorious: The song rises. The valley holds.
heartVoice.alt.vigilant.1: The light shifts. The dark is at the gates.
heartVoice.alt.vigilant.2: The spire stirs. The watch begins.
heartVoice.alt.warning.1: A lane wavers. The chord felt it before you did.
heartVoice.alt.warning.2: Something pushes harder than the rest. Look to it.
heartVoice.alt.danger.1: The walls are thinning. Elarion calls for you.
heartVoice.alt.danger.2: Two lanes at once. Keep your hands moving.
heartVoice.alt.critical.1: The chord breaks. Defend, Keeper - defend now.
heartVoice.alt.critical.2: The spire shudders. Hold the line at all costs.
heartVoice.alt.boss.1: He stands within the gate. Time slows. The light dims.
heartVoice.alt.boss.2: Alduin the Mournful walks the lane. Greet him with steel.
heartVoice.alt.victorious.1: The light returns. The village breathes again.
heartDamage.threshold75: The crystal flickers. The Heart has taken its first blow.
heartDamage.threshold50: Leaves fall in the wrong season. The song has gone thin.
heartDamage.threshold25: The bark is cracking. Hold, Keeper. Hold.
heartDamage.threshold10: The song is almost gone. Spend everything.
heartDamage.alt.threshold75: The flame flickers. The Lantern has taken its first blow.
heartDamage.alt.threshold50: Leaves fall in the wrong season. The warmth has gone thin.
heartDamage.alt.threshold25: The bark is splitting. Hold, Guardian. Hold.
heartDamage.alt.threshold10: The light is almost out. Spend everything.
victory.wave.1: They fall back. The Heart steadies. A breath, then the next.
victory.wave.2: The dark withdraws. Tend your companions. The song is not yet done.
victory.wave.3: The lanes hold. The folk light a candle for you.
victory.boss.1: Alduin breaks apart at the Heart's threshold. The Withering crawls home.
victory.boss.2: The valley sings. The folk weep. You are still the Keeper. The work begins again tomorrow.
victory.personalBest: None before you held so long. The old Keepers would have nodded.
victory.waveCleared.2: The chord holds. The watch breathes.
victory.waveCleared.3: The Folk light a candle for you.
victory.waveCleared.4: The lanes are quiet again. Tend your Wardens.
victory.waveCleared.5: A breath. A moment. The next tide will come.
victory.waveCleared.6: The wind cools. Elarion remembers your name.
defeat.1: The song stops. The folk look up. The wind feels cold for the first time.
defeat.2: The Heart breaks. But the bond does not. Begin again, Keeper - there is no other answer.
defeat.3: Elarion will return where it is needed. You will too.
defeat.alt.1: The light stops. The folk look up. The wind feels cold for the first time.
defeat.alt.2: The chord falters. But the bond does not. Begin again, Keeper.
petCaption.flamePup: (a warm yip, like a small bell)
petAmbient.aetherSprite.1: The Sprite watches you as you work. You do not know what it sees.
petAmbient.aetherSprite.2: It hums a single note, then forgets it.
petAmbient.aetherSprite.3: It glows brighter when you smile. You did not know that yet.
petAmbient.flamePup.1: The Pup is dreaming of fire again. Its tail twitches.
petAmbient.flamePup.2: It curled up on the warm stones at sunset. It has not moved since.
petAmbient.flamePup.3: It bared its teeth at a draft. The draft retreated.
petAmbient.iceWolf.1: Aldwin came back from the orchard with ice on his muzzle. You did not ask.
petAmbient.iceWolf.2: Aldwin pads silently. When the Hollowed come, he bares his teeth and does not look away.
petAmbient.iceWolf.3: His breath does not cloud. You wonder if he is breathing at all.
keeperAmbient.1: The Pup is dreaming of fire again. Its tail twitches.
keeperAmbient.2: The Mine is full. The Folk left a candle by the door this morning.
keeperAmbient.3: There is a song in the wood, faint and old. The Heart is humming.
keeperAmbient.4: The Sprite watches me as I work. I do not know what it sees.
keeperAmbient.5: The Folk leave bread in the workshop when they do not see me. I find it. I do not thank them yet.
keeperAmbient.6: Aldwin came back from the orchard with a scrap of ice on his muzzle. I asked. He did not say.
keeperAmbient.7: The Tower's lamp has been lit for ten thousand mornings. It is my turn to keep it.
keeperAmbient.8: I think the Heart sang me to sleep last night. I cannot tell anymore where its voice ends and mine begins.
milestone.firstPetLevelUp: The Sprite glows brighter. Something it could not do yesterday, it can do today.
milestone.firstSkillUnlocked: A new shape in the song. The Heart taught it while you slept.
milestone.firstBossKill: Alduin falls. The folk will sing about this evening for a hundred years.
milestone.firstStorePurchase: The wanderer bows. The folk will know your name in three valleys.
milestone.firstBuildingUpgrade: The Workshop bell is louder now. The Folk are pleased.
milestone.streak7Days: Seven mornings tending the song. The old Keepers would have called you 'one of ours' by now.
returningPlayer: Elarion kept your hearth warm. Welcome back, Keeper.
heroSelect.title: Defenders of the Realm
heroSelect.subtitle: powered by SKR
hero.mage.name: Thrain
hero.mage.blurb: An elder scholar of the crystal seams, his staff sings the cold awake. Where Thrain walks, the dark slows and the frost remembers every name it freezes.
hero.knight.name: Grom
hero.knight.blurb: Hammer in hand and the sun's emblem on his shield, Grom carries blessed steel into the breach. Where his light falls, the Hollowed falter and the walls hold.
hero.ranger.name: Sylas
hero.ranger.blurb: An elf of the green lanes who looses a clean arrow on the wind long before the dark draws near. Sylas reads the wood, snares the swift, and turns a tide arrow by arrow.
hero.cleric.name: Elara
hero.cleric.blurb: A vessel of the Heart's own light, Elara mends the wounded and wraps the faithful in holy ward. The dark cannot outlast a grace that rises faster than it can wound.
petSelect.title: Choose Your First Warden
petSelect.subtitle: A spirit will walk the watch beside you. Bond with one - it will know your kindness, and your battles.
elementBlurb.aether: Aether. The Heart's own light, shared and reshared. Mends what the dark has frayed.
elementBlurb.flame: Flame. The hearth's old defiance. Burns what would creep into the warm places.
elementBlurb.ice: Ice. The patient cold that holds the dark still until the song catches up.
resourceBlurb.crystals: Crystals. The Heart's slow gift. Mined where its overflow seeps up through the stone.
resourceBlurb.coins: Coins. Quiet currency, brought by the wanderers from valleys still standing. Spend them on what cannot be grown here.
buildingDesc.crystalMine: Where the Heart's gem-sap seeps into stone. Pets here tend the seam.
buildingDesc.petHouse: An ancient recess in the world tree's roots. The echoes rest here between battles, their presence a low hum in the stones.
buildingDesc.arcaneTower: Built by the first Keepers. Holds the ward-stones that answer your call.
buildingDesc.farm: Wheat that grows because the Heart wills it. Apples taste like the old summers.
buildingDesc.workshop: Hammer and forge. The Folk make what the Keeper needs and ask nothing.
buildingDesc.lumbermill: The sawmill's blade hums against timber the green places of Elarion still spare. Its planks brace the highest walls.
buildingDesc.forge: The armorer's fire never cools. Here the Folk beat raw iron into plate the Hollowed cannot easily bite through.
tooltip.resourceCrystals.title: Crystals
tooltip.resourceCrystals.body: The Heart's slow gift. Mined where its overflow seeps up through the stone.
tooltip.resourceCoins.title: Coins
tooltip.resourceCoins.body: Quiet currency, brought by the wanderers from valleys still standing. Spend it on what cannot be grown here.
tooltip.resourceVoidshards.title: Voidshards
tooltip.resourceVoidshards.body: Splinters of the Withering, left where a great Hollow One fell. The ward-stones drink them and grow strong.
tooltip.resourceStone.title: Stone
tooltip.resourceStone.body: Drawn from the valley's old bones. The walls remember the shape of it.
tooltip.resourceIron.title: Iron
tooltip.resourceIron.body: Cold metal from the deep seams. The Folk forge it into walls the dark cannot easily pass.
tooltip.resourceWood.title: Wood
tooltip.resourceWood.body: Fallen timber from the green places the Heart still keeps. It braces the highest walls.
tooltip.buttonWalls.title: The Walls
tooltip.buttonWalls.body: Raise the perimeter the Folk built around the Heart. Stone, iron and wood mend it higher.
tooltip.buttonTowers.title: The Towers
tooltip.buttonTowers.body: Stone spires raised by the first Keepers. Their ward-stones answer your call against the dark.
tooltip.buttonBuild.title: Build
tooltip.buttonBuild.body: Touch a marked ground to raise a spire, or the wall to mend it higher. The Folk do the rest.
tooltip.buttonSettings.title: The Keeper's Ledger
tooltip.buttonSettings.body: Hear the old story again, keep a copy of your watch, or begin a new one.
tooltip.buttonHelp.title: The Old Lessons
tooltip.buttonHelp.body: How to keep the watch - what the previous Keepers would have told you.
tooltip.buttonClan.title: The Other Valleys
tooltip.buttonClan.body: Join your watch to other Keepers, tend the roster, and trade word across the realm.
tooltip.buttonMailbox.title: The Mailbox
tooltip.buttonMailbox.body: Notes carried in by the wanderers. Send your own word with your invite mark.
tooltip.buttonHouse.title: Your Hall
tooltip.buttonHouse.body: All you have gathered - every spirit bonded, every place raised.
tooltip.waveTimerPill.title: The Dark Stirs
tooltip.waveTimerPill.body: A tide gathers beyond the walls. Gather what you can and ready your defenses.
tooltip.waveBegin.title: Call the Wave
tooltip.waveBegin.body: Do not wait for the dark. Meet it now, on your own watch.
tooltip.ability.mage.q.title: Arcane Bolt
tooltip.ability.mage.q.body: Your magic, but it is the Heart's gift. Use what is given - it returns when it can.
tooltip.ability.mage.w.title: Frost Nova
tooltip.ability.mage.w.body: For when a lane fails. The cold buys you a breath. Use the breath well.
tooltip.ability.mage.e.title: Healing Beacon
tooltip.ability.mage.e.body: Plant light where the dark gathers thickest. The Heart and all who stand near mend in it.
tooltip.ability.mage.r.title: Meteor Strike
tooltip.ability.mage.r.body: This is the deep magic. Spend it only when the Heart calls for it.
tooltip.ability.knight.q.title: Sword Strike
tooltip.ability.knight.q.body: Plain steel, close and sure. It asks nothing of the Heart and is always ready.
tooltip.ability.knight.w.title: Shield Bash
tooltip.ability.knight.w.body: Set your shield against the tide. The Hollow Ones falter, and you keep the line.
tooltip.ability.knight.e.title: Banner of Valor
tooltip.ability.knight.e.body: Raise the old colors. A whole rank of the dark is cut down where it stands.
tooltip.ability.knight.r.title: Vow of Iron
tooltip.ability.knight.r.body: A promise kept to the Heart. Its light floods back into the wound.
tooltip.ability.ranger.q.title: Quick Shot
tooltip.ability.ranger.q.body: A clean arrow loosed long. It costs nothing and the string is never still for long.
tooltip.ability.ranger.w.title: Snare Arrow
tooltip.ability.ranger.w.body: Pin a Hollow One to the ground. It will not reach the Heart's roots tonight.
tooltip.ability.ranger.e.title: Hawk's Eye
tooltip.ability.ranger.e.body: Aim true and far. One shot carries the weight of the dark you turn back.
tooltip.ability.ranger.r.title: Volley
tooltip.ability.ranger.r.body: Loose every arrow to the sky at once. They come down like a hard rain on the tide.
movementHint.joystick: Drag the joystick in the bottom-left corner to walk around the village.
movementHint.tap: Tap anywhere on the ground and your hero will walk there.
movementHint.both: Drag the joystick to move - or tap the ground to walk somewhere.
realmMap.revealHint: The realm beyond Elarion stirs. Visit the Wayshrine - the pale standing stone - to set out across the Realm Map.
shopkeeperPanic.1: My lord - ENEMIES! The shop can wait!
shopkeeperPanic.2: Goods later, glory now! To arms!
shopkeeperPanic.3: You want to shop? NOW?! Help us, please!
shopkeeperPanic.4: Coin won't save us from this lot - your magic will!
shopkeeperPanic.5: My lord, the till is barricaded! Get to the Heart!
shopkeeperPanic.6: Discounts after the wave, I swear it! Fight!
swap.title: Swap to SKR
swap.statusEnter: Enter an amount to see the rate.
swap.statusError: Could not fetch rate. Check connection.
promo.redeem.title: REDEEM A CODE
promo.redeem.blurb: Have a code from an event, a creator or the team? Enter it here.
promo.redeem.success: Code accepted - {0} added to your realm.
promo.redeem.successNoReward: Code accepted, but it carried no reward to add.
promo.redeem.error.invalid: We do not recognize that code. Check the spelling and try again - nothing was used up.
promo.redeem.error.alreadyUsed: You have already redeemed this code. Each code can be used once per player.
promo.redeem.error.expired: This code has expired and is no longer being accepted.
promo.redeem.error.playerLimit: You have reached the promo code limit for this account, so no more codes can be redeemed.
promo.redeem.error.offline: We could not reach the rewards server. Your code was NOT used - check your connection and try again.
promo.redeem.error.identity: We could not verify your account, so the code was NOT used. Sign in, then try again.
promo.redeem.error.signIn: Sign in before redeeming a code - rewards are tied to your account.
promo.redeem.error.unknown: Something went wrong on our end and the code was NOT used. Please try again in a moment.
feedback.title: Tell Us Honestly
feedback.body: Tell us what works, what does not, and what is missing. We read every response, and the thank-you is the same whatever you write.
feedback.placeholder: What is working, and what is not?
feedback.reward: One time only: 1000 wood, 1000 stone and 1000 iron, delivered in full.
feedback.storeCaption: Separate, and nothing is rewarded for it - no store tells us whether you did.
feedback.serviceUnavailable: We could not reach the feedback service just now. Please try again later.
feedback.storeUnavailable: The store link is not configured on this build.
feedback.thanks: Thank you - your words are with us. 1000 wood, 1000 stone and 1000 iron have been added to your stores, in full.
feedback.alreadyClaimed: Thank you - your words are with us. The thank-you was already claimed on this realm, so nothing was added this time.
feedback.grantUnavailable: Thank you - your words are with us. The thank-you could not be added right now; it is still owed to you and has not been used up.
feedback.tooShort: A few more words, please - at least {Minimum} characters.
feedback.noIdentity: We could not verify your account, so nothing was sent. Try again later.
feedback.serverRefused: The server did not accept that. Nothing was sent - please try again.
feedback.networkFailed: We could not reach the server. Your words were not sent; please try again.
feedback.overCapacity: Your {Resource} is now {AmountOver} above what your stores can hold. All of it is yours and stays yours; harvests and rewards into {Resource} simply pause until you spend back under.

jewelerFtue.body:
A rare item was recovered.
Sable can polish it into a refined gem.
jewelerFtue.guidance: Take it to Sable at the Jeweler.
jewelerFtue.stakeChecking: Checking the logged-in wallet for an active native SKR stake.
jewelerFtue.stakeVerified: Native SKR stake verified: +1 weekly re-roll added.
jewelerFtue.stakeVerifiedHighTier: Native SKR stake verified: +1 weekly re-roll added. Your 10,000+ SKR stake also raises the per-stone roll cap to 6.
jewelerFtue.stakeNotVerified: Native SKR stake not verified: no weekly re-roll was added.

jewelerPolish.body: Sable needs {Duration} to polish the stone. When the work is complete, the gem inside will be revealed.
jewelerPolish.started: Sable has begun polishing. Follow it in the Work Queue.
jewelerPolish.failed: The stone could not be placed on the bench.
jewelerPolish.noStone: There is no rough stone in your larder.
jewelerPolish.revealBody: Sable reveals a {Gem}. It has been added to your larder.

settings.difficulty.normalBlurb: The standard build window - about 5 minutes between waves.
settings.difficulty.hardBlurb: A short, tense build window - about 3 minutes between waves.
